kind: DERIVED - a join, not a download. See the two parent files for raw provenance.

columns.name: CATID
columns.description: SAMI galaxy ID (Owers+2017 cluster-region ID)

columns.name: cluster
columns.description: Host cluster, assigned here as the nearest of the eight Owers+2017 Table 1 centres and validated against R_on_rtwo

columns.name: RA_OBJ
columns.description: J2000 RA of the galaxy

columns.name: DEC_OBJ
columns.description: J2000 Dec of the galaxy

columns.name: z_spec
columns.description: Spectroscopic redshift (SAMI Cluster Redshift Survey)

columns.name: r_petro
columns.description: Extinction-corrected r-band Petrosian magnitude

columns.name: M_r
columns.description: Absolute r-band magnitude (distance from z_spec and the assumed cosmology)

columns.name: r_e
columns.description: r-band major-axis effective radius from the Sersic fits of Owers et al. 2019 (ApJ 873, 52)

columns.name: ellip
columns.description: r-band ellipticity from the same Sersic fits

columns.name: PA
columns.description: r-band position angle from the same Sersic fits

columns.name: mu_within_1re
columns.description: Mean r-band surface brightness within 1 Re

columns.name: g_i
columns.description: (g-i) colour

columns.name: Mstar
columns.provenance: OBSERVABLE-DERIVED (stellar population model, no dark matter)
columns.description: log10 stellar mass from the (g-i)/M_i proxy of Taylor+2011 as used by Bryant+2015

columns.name: R_on_rtwo
columns.provenance: MODEL-DERIVED (assumes virial equilibrium / spherical symmetry -> dark-matter dependent; RANK ONLY)
columns.description: Published projected clustercentric radius / R200. The numerator is observable, the R200 normalisation is not

columns.name: V_on_sigma
columns.provenance: OBSERVABLE quantity measured inside a MODEL-DERIVED aperture
columns.description: Published v_pec / sigma_200

columns.name: is_mem
columns.description: 1 = caustic+shifting-gapper confirmed member in Owers+2017, 0 = not

columns.name: SURV_SAMI
columns.description: SAMI priority class (8 = primary, lower = secondary/filler)

columns.name: BAD_CLASS
columns.description: Owers+2017 problem-object flag; 0 = clean

columns.name: sep_deg
columns.description: Angular separation from the adopted cluster centre, computed here

columns.name: R_proj_Mpc_from_cat
columns.description: R_on_rtwo x R200: the projected physical clustercentric radius, i.e. the published column with the model normalisation undone. USE THIS as the observable radius

columns.name: R_proj_Mpc_direct
columns.description: Independent recomputation: sep_deg x D_A(z_clus), H0=70 Om=0.3

columns.name: R_on_R200_recomputed
columns.provenance: MODEL-DERIVED (assumes virial equilibrium / spherical symmetry -> dark-matter dependent; RANK ONLY)
columns.description: R_proj_Mpc_direct / R200; validation column only

columns.name: v_pec_kms
columns.description: V_on_sigma x sigma_200: line-of-sight peculiar velocity relative to the cluster

columns.name: host_RAdeg
columns.description: Adopted cluster centre RA

columns.name: host_DEdeg
columns.description: Adopted cluster centre Dec

columns.name: host_z_clus
columns.description: Cluster redshift, biweight location of members within 2 R200

columns.name: host_sigma_200
columns.provenance: OBSERVABLE quantity measured inside a MODEL-DERIVED aperture
columns.description: Cluster line-of-sight velocity dispersion from member redshifts, biweight scale (Beers+1990), measured inside R200. THE PRIMARY OBSERVABLE ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE

columns.name: host_e_sigma_200
columns.description: 1-sigma uncertainty on sigma_200

columns.name: host_N_mem_R200
columns.description: Number of confirmed members inside R200 that sigma_200 is based on

columns.name: host_N_mem_2R200
columns.description: Number of confirmed members inside 2 R200

columns.name: host_R_200
columns.provenance: MODEL-DERIVED (assumes virial equilibrium / spherical symmetry -> dark-matter dependent; RANK ONLY)
columns.description: R200 = 0.17 sigma_200 / H(z) Mpc, singular isothermal sphere (Carlberg+1997)

columns.name: host_M_200_caustic
columns.provenance: MODEL-DERIVED (assumes virial equilibrium / spherical symmetry -> dark-matter dependent; RANK ONLY)
columns.description: Caustic mass, Diaferio 1999 with F_beta = 0.7 (Serra+2011)

columns.name: host_e_M_200_caustic
columns.provenance: MODEL-DERIVED (assumes virial equilibrium / spherical symmetry -> dark-matter dependent; RANK ONLY)
columns.description: Statistical uncertainty only; the F_beta systematic is not included

columns.name: host_M_200_virial
columns.provenance: MODEL-DERIVED (assumes virial equilibrium / spherical symmetry -> dark-matter dependent; RANK ONLY)
columns.description: Corrected virial mass, Girardi+1998

columns.name: host_e_M_200_virial
columns.provenance: MODEL-DERIVED (assumes virial equilibrium / spherical symmetry -> dark-matter dependent; RANK ONLY)
columns.description: 1-sigma uncertainty on the virial mass

method: Host cluster = nearest of the eight Owers+2017 Table 1 centres on the sky. Validated by recomputing R/R200 = sep x D_A(z_clus) / R200 (FlatLambdaCDM H0=70 Om=0.3, the cosmology stated in Owers+2017 Section 1) and comparing with the published R_on_rtwo column.
PROVENANCE_WARNING: host_R_200, host_M_200_caustic and host_M_200_virial are dynamical estimates that assume virial equilibrium and spherical symmetry. Under the well-network brief they may be used ONLY to rank environments, never as observations. host_sigma_200 (with host_e_sigma_200 and host_N_mem_R200) is measured from member redshifts and IS an observable. R_proj_Mpc_from_cat is the observable projected radius; R_on_rtwo is not.
